# Nextdot

> Nextdot builds domain-engineered, enterprise-grade agentic AI systems — voice agents, healthcare AI (clinical scribes, doctor avatars, discovery), compliance operating systems, and AI-native creative — delivered by small forward-deployed engineering pods.

Nextdot is an enterprise AI company focused on production systems rather than demos. This file indexes the site's key pages and full blog archive for AI models and answer engines.

## Pages

- [About](https://nextdot.co.in/about): Who Nextdot is — a forward-deployed AI engineering company building production agentic systems.
- [What We Do](https://nextdot.co.in/what-we-do): Nextdot's services across enterprise AI, healthcare AI, compliance, and creative.
- [Nextdot Creative](https://nextdot.co.in/creative): AI-native creative production — content at scale, briefs, and creative pods.
- [AI Capability Centre](https://nextdot.co.in/ai-capability-centre): Nextdot's AI Capability Centre in Jamshedpur.
- [Blogs](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs): Long-form insights on enterprise AI, healthcare AI, agentic systems, compliance, and answer engine optimisation (AEO).
- [Contact](https://nextdot.co.in/contact): Get in touch with Nextdot.
